source_note: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题
english_source_note: Deducing One Series Convergence from Another
callout_id: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题#6
statement_en: Let $a_n>0$ be a sequence, and suppose the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n$ converges. Prove that the series $\sum_{n\geq 3} a_n^{1-\frac{1}{\ln(n)}}$ also converges.
key_techniques: rewrite powers using exponentials and logarithms
callout_body: 序列$a_n>0$，级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$收敛，证明级数$\sum_{n\geq 3}a_n^{1-\frac{1}{\ln(n)}}$也收敛。
